show.description: Doctor Sahab Aur Cutie is a lighthearted romantic drama about fate, healing, and unexpected love. Dr. Arjun, a disciplined and aloof surgeon, crosses paths with bubbly and carefree Kavya, whose charm turns his orderly life upside down. As their worlds collide in hospitals, family drama, and heartfelt moments, their bond grows into a love story filled with laughter, warmth, and second chances.
